latestVersion.changelog:
- Added support for multiple workspaces with new tools: `list_workspaces` and `get_current_workspace`
- All main tools (`search_memos`, `global_search`, `list_memos`, `list_supertags`, `list_documents`, `create_memo`) now accept an optional `workspace_id` to target specific workspaces
- Updated research strategies and workflows to handle workspace context and cross-workspace research
- Improved documentation on workspace-aware behavior and clarified default vs explicit workspace usage
- Minor: Homepage URL updated to https://www.miremoapp.com
